objective: To improve access to irrigation, expand assured irrigation, improve on-farm water-use efficiency, reduce water wastage, and promote water-saving and precision-irrigation technologies.
main_benefits: Expansion of area under assured irrigation
Support for the goal of 'Per Drop More Crop'
eligibility: Eligibility and benefits vary according to the specific PMKSY component and implementing state/department.
application_process: The application process is component-specific and is implemented through the concerned state/department. Check the relevant component and state guidelines before applying.
